description: A cylinder (radius 9.38117860718074, height 16.731486953765412) in a skew pose cut in one call by two thin skew cylinders, then the ellipse edge one tool leaves on its side filleted at 0.05 (the multi-tool property a_multi_tool_result_is_an_operand_of_every_operation at the fixed seed 61727269732d70726f70657274792d74657374732d736565642d763100000000 and 1000 cases, CI run 41395171280, shard 3, shrunk): the fillet builds with the oracle's counts, one S5 pair of two NURBS blend faces left undecided as the corpus allows a blend, and measures 2.0e-4 more volume (0.34% of the 6.0e-2 the blend removes) and 3.9e-3 more area than Open CASCADE. The desired result matches Open CASCADE's measures, or a second oracle's record shows Arris's walked blend the nearer.
